//: Single source of truth for @packkit/core compatibility across the ecosystem. scripts/ecosystem-compatibility.mjs reads each consumer's main-branch package.json and asserts its declared @packkit/core range is consistent with core's own main-branch version. The ecosystem deliberately runs a BENIGN VERSION SPLIT: generators + surfaces pin an older core minor than the providers, because they only use additively-stable contract/protocol types. `split: "behind"` marks a consumer that is INTENTIONALLY allowed to trail core; anything not so marked must track the current core. A consumer requiring a core NEWER than core's main is always a hard failure (the real drift bug).

consumers.why: uses only additively-stable contract/protocol types; not composeFullstack/provider APIs
pins the minor that introduced composeFullstack; additive
